balls.text: No, they don't but finish on 158, which looked unlikely after the ten-over mark. Tossed up outside off, he hammers this to the right of long-off for four
Nails the yorker on the stumps, he jams this to long-on and does not run
Full down leg, called a wide
Has that hit the boundary cushion on the full? Nope, just short. Low full toss outside off, Gaikwad charges down and tonks it straight as an arrow.
Full on the stumps, he stays legside of the ball and scoops it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs
He's left this! Flatter angling across Gaikwad, who has shouldered arms
Tonked in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square. Low full toss on the stumps, he gets down on one knee and shellacks this in the gap

A tennis forehand from Overton but only as far as long-off who takes a comfortable catch. Banged in short on off, was the offcutter. Overton looks to clear the ropes but can't get enough power behind the shot and Shahrukh does the rest
Overton masterclass this! That is top innovation. Length ball on the stumps, he walks right across and helps this to the right of short fine leg
Not going to play for GT, these last few overs. Arshad not bowling to his field, at all. Slower back of a length ball angling across Overton. He frees his arms and carves that over short third
Straight as an arrow and Overton collects six! Right in the slot on middle stump, Overton stays legside of the ball and thumps that over the bowler's head

Just past a diving Gill at mid-off. Full angling across Overton on off at 140kph, he drives aerially to the left of Gill, who goes for a one-handed catch but the ball eludes him. Could he have with two hands?
Banged in short angling well across Overton outside off stump. But that's way too wide. Arshad has fallen in his follow-through and stays down. The physio runs out to have a look
Full down leg, called a wide
Fullish on the stumps, he shovels this to deep midwicket
Slower back of a length offcutter at 124kph outside off, Overton looks for a pull and misses

That's how you take catches says Jason Holder as he holds onto one at deep third. On-pace back of a length ball outside off, Kartik looks for a pull, gets a big top-edge that sails straight up. Holder does the rest
Sharp back of a length ball on off stump, Kartik misses the pull and is hit in the midriff
Slower off cutter on off stump, he gets inside the line and scoops this fine to the right of short fine leg

An absolute comedy of errors. Oh, dear, GT! Back of a length ball on off, Kartik looks to hammer that across the line and gets a bit of a top-edge. The ball drops right in between Suthar at deep square leg and Rashid at deep midwicket. Both fielders look at each other and neither go for the catch in the end. What's worse, the ball goes for four
Was looking to send that out of Chepauk, only skews it as far as long-on. Backs away outside leg stump, but Rabada follows him. Gaikwad looks to flay that across the line, can only toe-end this
Dropped just short of the incoming Shahrukh Khan. Short of a length ball outside off at 128kph, Gaikwad ramps, not off the middle of the bat and the ball does not carry to deep third
Banged in short at 131.3kph outside off, he ramps this fine but deep third is in place
Nails the yorker outside off stump, Kartik gets a bit cheeky and eyes a scoop. Ends up getting hit on the boot and losing his footing
Ah, misses out there. Right in the slot outside off, he tries smacking that a bit too hard and ends up shovelling this to midwicket
Fourth six for Gaikwad! Length ball on off stump, he crashes that across the line and the ball sails over deep midwicket for a 70m six
Good running from Kartik and Gaikwad reaches a 49-ball fifty. His first fifty of IPL 2026.  On a length on off stump, he works this to wide long-on
Banged in short on leg stump, he pulls neatly for a couple of runs to the right of deep backward square leg.
Rising back of a length ball on off stump, he defends
Back of a length ball angling across Kartik who gets going by tapping Arshad past backward point
TIMBER! If you guys won't catch it, I'll clean up the stumps, says Arshad. Length ball on off stump, Dube looks to go across the line, misses and sees his off pole flattened
Sharp good length ball on middle stump, thuds into his thigh pad

Oh, dear, Siraj! He's absolutely made a meal of this. Hard lengths on off stump, with the ball getting big on Dube. He gets it high on the bat with the ball lobbing to Siraj at mid-off. He just had to take one step forward and the catch would have been in his lap. But he stays still, then has to dive forward and ends up completely missing it
Flatter on off stump, he brings out a big sweep and hammers this to the left of short fine leg to end an impressive over for CSK

Jos is having a shocker! Flatter length ball on the stumps, he gets a thick inside-edge to the on-side with Buttler moving across quickly. The batters weren't really looking for a run but Buttler fires a needless throw at the non-striker's end and concedes an overthrow
Going, going, gone! That is a clean hit! Tossed up on off stump but right in Dube's slot. He takes a couple of steps down the track and shellacks this straight over the sightscreen for a huge six

Sai Sudharsan runs in but can't hold on to what would have been a terrific catch. Googly on middle stump, he looks to whack that across the line and mistimes this to deep midwicket , where BSS hares in, dives but only manages fingertips to it
Goes awry, and Buttler can't get across in time to cut it; five wides a result. Flatter and down leg
Tossed up but ends up being a low full. Gaikwad can't cash in though. Ends up mistiming an attempted drive to the on-side
Fuller and flatter outside off stump, Gaikwad looks to flay that away but misses
Fuller on a length on middle and leg at 126.8kph, he works to deep midwicket
Short of a length ball on middle, he pulls by rolling his wrists down to deep midwicket
Rising good length ball on off stump, he pushes to cover
Back of a length ball at 130.9kph outside off, the ball sticks into the surface as Dube mistimes to mid-off
On a length on off and middle, he prods that foot front across and works to deep midwicket

Pulled away for six more! A third six for Gaikwad in his last seven balls. He's finally getting a move on. Banged in short on middle stump, he gets inside the line and helps it over the deep fine leg fence
A misfield from Gill allows Gaikwad three, when it should have been one. Fuller outside off, he laces a drive on the up to the right of Gill, who lets it through
On the fuller side of length angling across Gaikwad who prods forward and drives to extra cover

A second six in the over for Gaikwad. Arshad tests Gaikwad with a back of a length ball on middle stump, he is ready for it and sends the pull flat and hard in the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Good length ball outside off, he pats this to backward point

He FINALLY gets one away! Will this break the shackles for Gaikwad? Length ball on middle and leg, he stays leg side of the ball and absolute pummels that across the line for a huge six over deep midwicket

Pinned him on the right bicep! Ouch, that's bound to hurt. He flings the bat away and is down on his haunches. Rising short of a length ball on leg stump, Gaikwad looks to give the charge in a bid to flay this away across the line. Gets nowhere near it with the ball getting big on him. The physio runs out to tend to him. He wrings his hand but is good to continue
CSK finally get a boundary! It's taken 12 overs for them to reach 50. Short of a length ball down leg, he helps this to the right of short fine leg for a welcome four
On a length on off stump, Dube crashes this but only straight back at Holder
Slower back of a length ball on off stump, he pulls to the right of long-on for a run
Slower bouncer on off and middle, but this one is too high. Called a wide
Short and wide, Gaikwad cuts this hard but can't get it past backward point
Back of a length ball outside off, flat-batted back to the bowler
Banged in short on middle stump, he gets inside the line and looks for a pull but can't lay a bat on ball
Just the two runs off Arshad's first over. Back of a length ball on off stump, he works to the right of midwicket for a run
Length ball on off stump, he turns this towards midwicket and sets off only to be sent back by Dube
Good length ball angling across Gaikwad, who shapes up for a cut and misses
On the fuller side of length, Gaikwad takes a couple of steps down the track and pushes to mid-off
Gaikwad is now beaten. Back of a length ball angling across the batter, who looks for a pull and is beaten

Dropped first ball? Looks like from the expression of the GT fielders. But the umpire gives it a leg-bye. But it sounded woody. Excellent start to Arshad's IPL 2026. Gets the ball to land on a length on middle stump and cuts Dube into half. The ball does indeed catch his inside-edge through to Buttler who makes a meal of it. Just feels like Buttler was not expecting it and was rushed, which saw him grabbing the ball with hard hands
Back of length ball delivered from the edge of the crease, flicked to midwicket
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket
Low bounce off a hard length. Comes in at off, Gaikwad gets low to flick it to midwicket
Tight single to mid-off, no direct hit at non-striker's. Dube drove that full ball from the crease and took a couple of steps before going full pace. Would've just made it even if Siraj had hit
Length on off, looks to defend straight. Gets it into the pitch, almost like it went off the toe
Pace use, angle use, four wide of third. Back of length around off, Dube stays leg side and cupcake creams it late, with a horizontal bat. On top of the bounce, from rib-height
Lbw appeal turned down. Touch too straight. Length on leg, went with the arm and beat the flick
Length outside off, spins away and beats the cut. Good bounce too
Full outside off, driven to long-off
Full outside off, angling away. Dube wants to drive to cover, loses his bottom hand, gets it to the bowler's left

No-look out! Gill takes the high ball at cover, well in the ring too. Pace in the early 80ks, fullish ball lands on middle and turns away. That's what did Brevis in. He made room and went for a swipe over long-on, diagonal-bat swipe. Bounce on the ball meant it took the top edge and went in the other direction.
Pitched up on middle and off, flicked to deep midwicket
Fullish on off, defended towards cover
Back of length over off, defended towards backward point. Wanted to run it to third, goes too high off the bat

Wide release from Holder may have cost him an lbw. He's keen and Gill takes the DRS. Holder's walking back as the replay comes as it's hitting just below the outer-half of the front knee-roll. Length ball on leg beats the hoick across the line aimed over square leg. Umpire's call impact and going well down leg
Fullish length ball on leg, flicked to midwicket
Tall-bowler bounce. 130ks back of length ball lifts to rib-height over leg. Brevis waits till it approaches his body and clips it onto the pitch in front
Length just outside off, thick outside edge off the cover drive goes to deep third
Full on off, punched to long-off
Pitched up outside off, driven to deep cover
90ks on a length around off, steered to backward point with a sliding square drive
Full on middle and leg, driven square on the off side
Wide on a length, spins away and is let go. 92ks but looked slow
Fullish on off, defended to cover
Fullish outside off, hoovered to long-on
Very short, pacy at 148ks but Gaikwad sees it early. Drops his hands, sways back and lets it pass over off
Cover drive deserved four, Rashid at cover point half-stops it to the right 146ks pitched up just outside off, Brevis drives slightly on the rise. Firm punch, holds his shape
Pitched up around off, driven to cover point
Guided to deep third. Hard length on fourth, Gaikwas plays it off the vertical bat almost after it passes him
Length just outside off, square driven along the ground to point
146ks fullish length ball in the channel, punched to cover
Fullish on off, punched to mid-on
Bouncer over leg, Brevis ducks under it early

Golden duck for the impact sub. Sarfaraz wants to pull his first ball over square leg for six. But it's a cross seamer that skids through just over off. Bat went from slightly low to high. Like Tendulkar vs McGrath in the 2003 final. This one though, went back to the keeper
Fullish on a length, flicked to mdwicket's right
Length on off, defended to point
Touch too straight for the lbw. Length ball on leg, beats the flick and hits high on the front pad

Urvil's aggression lasts two balls, Rabada too hostile and accurate. He goes hard length at 149ks after being driven off a full length. Same line - around leg stump. Urvil made room but not enough, cramped on the flat-bat hit down the ground. Top-edge goes to mid-on's left
Shottt! Dispatches pace with disdain! Makes room while dancing down, gets a fullish pace-on ball at leg. Would've been rising had he stayed in place, but laced a drive through cover drive
Fullish just outside off, punched to cover

Samson beaten by jaffas from Siraj, nicked by a shorty widey ball from Rabada. More length but with that width, it's made for the cut. 148ks, Samson reaches out for the cut with the upper body and no footwork, wanted to go square. Got a thin edge off the bottom of the bat that flew to Buttler's right
Length around off, 147ks, punched defensively down the ground
Rabada fixes his length, close to back of length but not exactly there. At 146ks, it rises well above off. Samson looks to heave it with a cross-bat over mid-off, over the top edge it flies
Back of length outside off, square driven on top of the bounce to deep point
Siraj appeals for a while but that looked down leg. No review. Slightly scrambled seam, on a back of length, Gaikwad was beaten on the flick
Length in the channel, back-foot punch to cover point
Slower one? No, 137ks. Seemed like it took a while to go from the pitch to the bat. Length ball just outside off, Gaikwad waits and punches to mid-off
Siraj does everything wrong, rewarded with a boundary. Change in line but this is too straight, length is full enough for Gaikwad to glance it aerially. Through fine leg

Siraj does everything right, rewarded with a boundary. Length ball swings away just outside off, the pace and bounce are even. Gaikwad waits till the ball approaches his front leg to punch it through cover
Length on off, defended to the off side of the pitch
Rabada's hard lengths getting hit hard. Sixth-stump line allows Samson to reach out without foot-movement and flat-bat it over mid-off

Nice fielding by Siraj. Ran right for a while from long leg, got his hands low and picked up the ball while rolling. Good throw too. Was a length ball outside off, Samson went for the cut. French cut it off the bottom-edge
Rabada going fuller. At off, Samson goes for the straight drive. Gets it off the inside-half to midwicket
Won't miss out twice Samson. Cuts over cover point to bring up 5000 IPL runs. Scramble-seam back of length ball but at hip-high, not as much bounce and it's hit over the infield
Bad ball but gets extra bounce to beat the cut. Back of a length outside off, a bit of swing away. Bangs the pitch and rises around stomach-height, all hands from Samson
Back of length just outside off, allows Samson to go back and open the face to run it to deep third
Length on leg, nudged to the leg side of the pitch

Siraj could've had a hat-trick by now on another day. Smiles and has a word with Samson after beating the outer edge again. Fullish length ball just outside off, late swing to beat the straight bat. Samson not reaching forward
Outswinger beats him again. Late swing, fuller side of the length on off again. Samson looks to defend straight, hands not as away from the body as the first ball. Beaten again
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket
Seam, bounce! 133ks length ball comes in to land on off and goes away big. Samson follows it a touch, looks to defend to cover and retreats. Pokey pokey at the end. Beaten

That's that! GT back to winning ways after two defeats; CSK lose at home. Buttler hits the winning runs. Fullish on the stumps, he jumps down the track and smacks this straight down the ground for a big six. GT win by eight wickets with 20 balls to spare.
Dragged down outside off, he pulls to deep midwicket to get off the mark

A little too late, but Brevis has taken a stunner to see the back of Sai Sudharsan. Dragged down outside off, he absolutely shellacks the pull to the right of Brevis at deep midwicket, who runs to his right, flings out both hands and takes an excellent diving catch.
Flatter on middle and leg, he works this to deep backward square leg

HELPED INTO THE STANDS! The Chennai boy is reigning supreme for the Titans. Back of a hand slower ball on his hips, he gets inside the line and helps this over deep backward square leg. SEVENTH six for Sudharsan.
Fullish in length on the pads of Buttler who clips to deep midwicket
length ball on middle and leg, he works this to deep midwicket
Angles the good length ball on off, he opens the face of the bat and steers to deep third
On a length on middle stump, he works this to deep midwicket
BSS on the charge and he is peppering the straight boundary! Back of a slower ball on the stumps, he charges down the track and slams him over his head clearing the field comfortably
Slightly short on middle and leg, BSS pulls this hard to deep backward square leg
Pushed quicker outside off, he nudges to short third with an open face of the bat
On a length just outside off, patted to cover
Big appeal for lbw, not given. Googly that lands on a length on middle turning away from Buttler, who misses and is hit on the pad. That was going high though
Fullish on middle stump, he works this to deep midwicket
Straight down the ground and BSS is racing. Floated outside off stump, he shimmies down the track and plunders it for a huge six
Two in two! Back of a length ball outside off, but the width is the key. Buttler frees his arms and steers this to the left of backward point
Pulled in the gap, pulled for four. Short of a length ball on leg stump, he helps this nonchalantly to the left of deep backward square leg
Good length ball on the stumps, he works this to the on-side
Banged in short at 148kph but down leg, called a wide. JOverton is not happy with the call

Dropped by Samson to his left.  That should have been taken, really. Good length ball just outside off, he looks to steer that fine, but the ball is closer to him and also gets a little bigger. Samson goes with one hand, when he should have with two. The ball hits the hard part of his gloves and pops out. He nearly concedes four more, with the ball going perilously close to the helmet
On a length on middle stump, he works this to deep backward square leg
Huge appeal from Samson, but only him. Nothing from the umpire. Back of a length ball on off stump, he looks for a short arm jab and is beaten in the inside-edge
Long hop and Sai Sudharsan will keep tonking them all day long. Just around off stump, he rocks back and pummels a pull over cow corner to move into the 60s
Pushed quicker on middle, he works this to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, he opens the face of the bat and carves to deep point
Length ball outside off, he stays back and punches to extra cover
Marginally short outside off, he stays back and cuts to deep point

OUT OF THE PARK! Horrible drag-down down leg, he gets inside the line and helps it over deep backward square leg with minimum of fuss. He loses his footing at the end of the shot but doesn't trod onto his stumps
Short and wide outside off, he stays back and cuts to deep backward point
Legbreak on the stumps, he works this to deep midwicket for a run
Googly outside off, he pats this to backward point who lets it through his legs and concedes two
Beaten! Googly floated away from Buttler, who looks for an aerial drive over covers but misses. Samson whips off the bails in a flash but Buttler is in
Oof, vintage Buttler. All timing from him. Floated on middle and leg, he flicks this imperiously through midwicket
Fifty for BSS, off just 33 balls, another solid knock from him. Tossed up on middle and leg, he works it to deep backward square leg for a run
Flatter sliding across BSS, who runs this fine but can't beat Gurjapneet at short third
Flatter length ball on the shorter side just around off, he shovels this to deep midwicket with soft hands for two

Is his foot touching the boundary cushion? Oh, it is touch and go but think it is. Regardless that is a SENSATIONAL effort from Brevis at long-on. Floated on the stumps, he jumps down the track and gets a little too much under the ball and tonks it very high into the night sky. The ball juuust evades Brevis who takes it one-handed behind him and then could have released the ball. But what he does is tries to flick it further back towards the fielder close to him and in doing that, his foot touches the ground beyond the boundary
Angled into Buttler on the fuller side on off, he works this to deep midwicket
Ooh, Samson doesn't get near it. Slower through the air outside off, Buttler looks for a reverse, but the ball takes the top-edge onto helmet and drops in front of the wicket
Dragged down outside off, he stays back and pulls to deep midwicket
Walks towards the length ball is driven through cover. Ample time for Buttler with the lack of pace
Massive sound... doesn't carry! Samson falls forward and takes it on the bounce. Shortish ball over the stumps, Buttler made room and flapped hard for the cut. Top edge almost spun off the bat
Good stop at short third by Kamboj. Moved right and stopped it low. Was a good shot, late guide with an open face off the front foot
Walks down and across, gets inside the line of the shortish ball and pulls it off the hips to deep square leg
Looked like that swung away a bit. Might be eyes playing tricks on me. Length outside off, punched to cover
Guides it towards short third and takes off. Was a tight run, no direct hit at the striker's
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket. Timeout

Stolen two. Deep midwicket charges in and picks it up just past the ring but Sudharsan - who called early - makes it back in time. There is an ongoing check for a short run though... and Sudharsan did not get past the crease at the non-striker's. Stopped just inside despite reaching out with his body and bat. Was a length ball that was flicked softly
Fullish length ball on leg, flicked to deep square leg
Touch back of length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket. Kind of a wasted ball from Noor with a slip in
Wide and full, square driven to deep cover
Length on leg, flicked to short fine leg
Length on leg, glanced to deep fine leg

Dances down and drives straight of mid-off. Got it on a full length, almost a half-volley, and drove hard. Bat did turn in a bit but there was enough power for it to race away and beat the diving fielder
Length on off from around, Buttler looks to whack it across the line. Bat turns inwards and ball dribbles to long-on
Fullish on off, thick inside edge off the cover drive goes to deep square leg
Pitched up on off, driven to long-off
Pitched up on off, driven to mid-on
Edge? No. Buttler glued to the crease as he looked to punch it off the back foot to cover. The length ball canted away outside off, bounced extra and popped off Samson's gloves before he took it
Touch short on off, 95ks, pulled to deep midwicket
Drifts in to cut room out. Length on leg, SUdharsan flicks it softly to the leg side
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket

Appeal for stumping, sent up to third ump. 98ks length ball landed just down leg and went past the flick. Gill's back foot slid just outside the crease as Samson collected the ball and pushed the bails off his right hand. He was sliding leg side, didn't let the momentum carry his hands back. Gill's foot is centimetres in the air, if at all that, and that's enough for the third umpire to rule him out quickly
Pitched up just outside off, worked to long-on
Length on off, square driven off the back foot to deep point
Pitched up around off, Gill pushes it towards cover and takes right off for the single
Pitched up on off, driven back to the bowler
Pitched up outside off, pushed towards cover point

Inside edge goes wide of leg stump and fine to bring up GT's fifty. Much, much faster than CSK to the mark. Was a length ball outside off, Sudharsan collapsed as he drove that through cover and got done in by the lack of room and bounce

Hosein might have been hit in the face. He rolls to the right at deep point and holds his face in front of his right eye. He moved just a couple of steps but the ball hovered low and rapidly, so he had to go down quickly. Slid on one knee, got both hands on the ball as he fell to the right. Unfortunately, he went head first into the ground, the bones around the eye look to have taken first impact and the head bounced off the turf. Not as bad as yesterday's mishap with Ngidi. He remains on the field after the physios came in and checked. Was a length ball on top of middle, Gill made room and danced down to slap it on top of the bounce
Slot ball has been pumped. 131ks on middle and leg, Gill takes a good stride forward and stays beside the line to ease a lofted drive

Noice. Sudharsan opens the face and stabs the vertical bat towards cover to slice the length ball to short third's left. Kartik fumbles to the left and half-stops it. Ball rolls to the deep-third fence as the bowler hides his face
One-handed on-drive. Sudharsan was too early into the shot despite the low full toss arriving at him at 139ks, bent well forward as he hit it. Decently timed though
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg. 137ks
Nudges it off the pad to the leg side

Sudharsan goes across for the scoop, gets it but from very high off the bat. Went a little too far to the right of the keeper, else that would've been out. Was on a length well outside off, Sudharsan got low and tried to pick it from over the shoulder
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket
Bit of room and into the pitch, 131ks, allows Sudharsan to middle a cut. Finds cover.
Length on off, angles the bat and defends towards backward point
Length around off, worked with a closed face back to the bowler
Hard length around off, defended towards cover point
Length outside off, guided to cover point
Kamboj almost knocks Gill over. Skids one through back of length and it bounces inches over middle stump. Gill made room and charged, was a touch too far and slow as he played the cut
Fullish on leg, glicked to deep forward square
Shortish ball just outside off, guided to deep third
Much easier help-along six for Sudharsan. Got the back of length ball around hip-height, he had to get slightly low before swivelling and combing the flick with a hook to send the ball fine
Length on leg, pushed to midwicket for a quick run. 143ks

Top-edged pull sails fine for six. Bouncer dug in at pace, rose under the armpit at good pace. The angle was in towards middle and leg, Gill leant across to get slightly inside the ball and went through with the shot
Pulled along the ground to the midwicket outfield. Gill crouching a touch and getting the wrists a touch low in front of the body to the back-of-length ball
Nice cut to deep cover-point, Gill wanted two but settles for one. Back of length outside off, Gill coils upright and slaps it late
Hard length just outside off, chomped off the vertical bat to the bowler's left

Inside edge might've saved Gill. 133ks fullish length ball, a physical wobble on the ball. Gill looked to punch it straight. From the replay, it looks like bat first clearly and then pad before ball rolled leg side
Wide on a hard length, cut to deep-backward point
Low bounce from a back of length, pulled from outside off to midwicket

Moves away to induce a poke from Sudharsan. It was a subtle wobble ball with the seam going from slip to leg slip, landed on off and went well outside. Batter reached out with the hands before pulling back and getting beaten
Makes room and gets followed by a fullish length ball. Defended towards cover
Touch too full and Gill step-hits it over long-on. Graceful swing with an easy back-lift and follow-through. Hit from in front of the body

Short third is fine and that allows Gill to get away. Gurjapneet was more of a backward point, he tripped on the boundary cushion at deep third and thudded into the boundary. Got his hands in front to save himself. It was full and flighted on off, Gill made room and looked to go over cover. Got a thick edge
Makes room for an inside-out drive. The length ball is slow and comes down leg, Gill pulls some power out and gets it to point
Fullish on off, pushed towards cover
Length on off, 90ks, flicked to deep square leg
